title: When the AI Leaves the Tailorshop: Measuring What an LLM Advisor Leaves Behind in Complex Problem Solving
abstract: arXiv:2610.00163v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Complex problem solving depends on acting effectively and understanding how a system works. AI advice may support these outcomes unequally. Two preregistered experiments compared participants managing a simulated clothing factory with and without an LLM advisor. Across studies, AI-supported participants reported greater confidence and understanding with less effort. In the first study (N=200), assistance increased company value but produced no detectable prediction-accuracy difference. After withdrawal, previously supported participants outperformed controls when decisions were scored against repeating previous choices, but not default settings. Within the AI-supported group, more frequent recommendation alterations predicted better unaided performance. translated_title: 当AI离开裁缝铺：衡量大语言模型顾问在复杂问题解决中留下的东西
translated_abstract: 复杂问题解决既依赖于有效行动，也依赖于对系统运作方式的理解，而AI建议对这两方面的支持可能并不均等。两项预注册实验比较了参与者在大语言模型（LLM）顾问辅助与非辅助条件下管理一家模拟服装工厂的表现。在两项研究中，获得AI支持的参与者均报告了更高的信心与理解程度，且付出更少的努力。在第一项研究（N=200）中，AI辅助提高了公司价值，但未检测到预测准确率上的差异。在撤除AI辅助之后，当决策以是否重复先前选择来评分时，先前获得支持的参与者表现优于对照组，但以默认设置为评分标准时则无此优势。在AI支持组内部，更频繁地修改AI建议预示着无辅助条件下更好的表现。在第二项研究（N=198）中，获得AI支持的参与者破产次数更少，并在注册分析中表现出小幅的知识优势，这主要与保持偿债能力相关（摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究通过两项预注册实验发现，大语言模型顾问能提升人们在模拟复杂问题解决中的表现、信心与知识，且在AI撤除后，那些更频繁修改AI建议的参与者展现出更强的独立解决问题能力。
en_tdlr: Through two preregistered experiments, this study finds that an LLM advisor improves performance, confidence, and knowledge in complex problem solving, and after its withdrawal, participants who more frequently altered its recommendations performed better unaided.
